checks.name: capture_stop 实际宿主返回
checks.command:
"$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_jtag_retry_20261009_120653_r01'
$identityPath=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'uart_capture_identity.json'
$identity=Get-Content -LiteralPath $identityPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$captureProcess=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId="+$identity.pid)
if ($null -eq $captureProcess -or [string]$captureProcess.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc() -cne $identity.creation_time_filetime_utc -or $captureProcess.ExecutablePath -cne $identity.executable_path -or $captureProcess.CommandLine -cne $identity.command_line) { throw '采集进程身份变化，拒绝操作' }
$stopPath=$identity.stop_flag
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stopPath) { throw '停止标志已存在，拒绝覆盖' }
$stopStream=[IO.File]::Open($stopPath,[IO.FileMode]::CreateNew,[IO.FileAccess]::Write,[IO.FileShare]::Read)
try { $stopBytes=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes('本次下载前双核停止门禁失败，未初始化；保留空串口原始证据并正常关闭采集。'+[Environment]::NewLine); $stopStream.Write($stopBytes,0,$stopBytes.Length); $stopStream.Flush() } finally { $stopStream.Dispose() }
$process=Get-Process -Id $identity.pid
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(10000)) { throw '采集进程没有在10秒内退出，保留日志待诊断' }
$raw=Get-Item -LiteralPath $identity.raw_path
$stdoutPath=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'uart_capture_stdout.log'
$stdout=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($stdoutPath,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false,$true))
if (-not $stdout.Contains('CAPTURE_CLOSED ')) { throw '退出后没有关闭记录' }
[pscustomobject]@{status='CAPTURE_CLOSED_OBSERVED';pid=$identity.pid;stop_flag=$stopPath;raw_bytes=$raw.Length;raw_sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $raw.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();stdout=$stdout;observed_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');process_exit_code=$process.ExitCode} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"
